'''Ghandruk Sign Language''' ({{langx|ne|घान्द्रुक सांकेतिक भाषा|translit=Ghandruk Sāṅkētika Bhāṣā}}) is a [[village sign language]] of the [[Village development committee (Nepal)|Village Development Committee]] of [[Ghandruk]] in central [[Nepal]].
